location: 2 CFR part 200; 5 CFR part 1315; 48 CFR parts 9904, 9905

en.title: Office of Management and Budget: 4 references to U.S. Code sections repealed, omitted or not in the Code
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Office of Management and Budget, 4 references in 4 sections cite a U.S. Code section that release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code does not carry in force: 2 cite a number the Code does not have; 2 cite a repealed section. The release names no successor for these sections.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references does not reach the text the rule relies on. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides whether to remove or replace each reference. The U.S. Code names no successor for these sections.
